_source: SIA 265:2021, clause 4.2.9, equations (38) to (44) -- transcribed by hand from the German edition, ExternalFiles/000-Normes/SIA265-2021-DE.pdf p. 36, read off a render of the page (the radicals of (40), (42), (43) and (44) do not extract as text).
_note: k_m = 1 for lambda_rel,m <= lower_bound; k_m = intercept - slope · lambda_rel,m for lower_bound < lambda_rel,m <= upper_bound; k_m = 1/lambda_rel,m^2 for upper_bound < lambda_rel,m (39). The norm prints the middle condition as "0,75 · lambda_rel,m <= 1,4", a misprint for "0,75 < lambda_rel,m <= 1,4" (Figur 11). lambda_rel,m = sqrt(f_m,k / sigma_m,crit) (40); for a rectangle b x h under a constant moment with lateral supports a apart, approximately sigma_m,crit = sigma_m_crit_factor · E_0,05 · b^2/(a · h) (41), i.e. lambda_rel,m = lambda_rel_m_factor · sqrt(a · h)/b · sqrt(f_m,k / E_0,05) (42), 1.15 being 1/sqrt(0.75) rounded. f_m,k from Tabelle 8 or 9, E_0,05 from Anhang B. simplified_factors are the Nadelholz shortcut of (43)/(44), lambda_rel,m = factor · sqrt(a · h)/b, kept for the record.
